AI Engineer (Entry Level) | Python, RAG, LLM Evaluation | B.Tech Computer Science 2026

about: I build retrieval-augmented LLM applications in Python: the pipeline, the API around it, and the evaluation that says whether the answers can be trusted.

At Kestrel Data Labs I built a RAG chatbot over 1,200 internal support documents with LangChain and FastAPI. It cut the average answer lookup time from 6 minutes to under 1 minute. Before release I wrote an evaluation script that scored 150 question-answer pairs for groundedness and caught 18 hallucinated answers.

On my own time I built DocQuery, a FastAPI service that answers questions over uploaded PDFs using embeddings stored in PostgreSQL with pgvector. It is containerised with Docker and deployed through a GitHub Actions pipeline.
I graduate with a B.Tech in Computer Science in 2026 and I am looking for a remote, entry-level Generative AI Developer or AI Engineer role. Message me here or use the email on my profile.
